summary: Bilibili Inc. furnished a Form 6-K comprising its 2026 interim report (Exhibit 99.1) for the six months ending December 31, 2026, prepared to satisfy Hong Kong Listing Rule 13.48(1) for a Hong Kong-listed issuer, the equivalent of a US half-year report on Form 6-K. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor are disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic disclosure, signed by CFO Xin Fan on September 24, 2026; there is no special-situation event, so no risk-arb angle applies.
